page_title: TOT 2-0 MNU | Tottenham Hotspur v Manchester Utd 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+10' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
90+6' Manchester Utd earn a corner.

90+2' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the middle of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

90+1' Casemiro (Manchester United) latched on to an accurate cross inside the box and attempted to direct the ball with a nice header towards the net, but the goalkeeper reacted quickly to keep the ball out.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
89' The attendance is 61910.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Emerson Royal (Tottenham) coming on for Pedro Porro.
88' The substitution has been made. Manor Solomon (Tottenham) has replaced Dejan Kulusevski.
85' Erik ten Hag has decided to make a change. Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United) replaces Mason Mount.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anthony Martial (Manchester United) replaces Marcus Rashford.

83' 2 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the bottom right corner of his own goal.
81' Casemiro (Manchester United) picks up the rebound on the edge of the box and shoots. His effort, however, only finds the gloves of the opponent's goalkeeper.
76' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Pape Matar Sarr is replaced by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham).
74' The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.

66' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antony.
66' Erik ten Hag has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) replacing Aaron Wan-Bissaka.
66' That will be all from Alejandro Garnacho who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jadon Sancho (Manchester United).
64' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
63' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Michael Oliver ignores the protests.
62' The resulting corner from James Maddison (Tottenham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
62' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play and Tottenham manage to earn a corner.
61' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
60' The game is interrupted as Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is flagged offside.

60' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Guglielmo Vicario guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
58' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
58' Manchester Utd get a corner.

57' Casemiro (Manchester United) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net, but Guglielmo Vicario keeps the ball out.
54' The corner is swung in but Tottenham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

53' A pass travels right across the box to Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the middle of the goal, but Andre Onana denies him with a decent save.
52' OFF THE WOODWORK! Antony (Manchester United) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!
49' 1 - 0 Goal! Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
40' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) latches on to a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a brilliant shot towards the goal, but he hits the crossbar!
39' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is booked for saying more than Michael Oliver was willing to tolerate.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antony (Manchester United) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) who loops his header high over the bar.
36' Tottenham are ruled offside.
33' The referee Michael Oliver awards Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) a yellow card.
33' Antony (Manchester United) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.

30' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Andre Onana pulls off a brilliant save.
29' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) is penalised for holding. Michael Oliver signals a set piece.
29' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

27' That's unlucky! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester Utd.

25' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Andre Onana to get hold of the ball.
25' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
24' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar.
22' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

20' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
19' James Maddison (Tottenham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
19' Michael Oliver blows his whistle after Casemiro (Manchester United) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Tottenham.
18' Tottenham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
17' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
16' James Maddison (Tottenham) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
14' A pass lands at the feet of Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
13' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Guglielmo Vicario.
11' One of the players from Manchester Utd times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
10' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Raphael Varane (Manchester United) sends a wild header high over the bar.
10' Mason Mount (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
10' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
7' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
2' Antony (Manchester United) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
2' Casemiro (Manchester United) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
